messages:
incident-bot: P1 Alert -> observability: Datadog ingestion delay detected in eu-central-1 for logs and metrics. Paging @oncall. Follow runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/obs-dd-ingest
anna: I'm oncall, reading. Dashboards show metric gaps and delayed logs. Traces seem partial. Starting triage.
datadog-status-bot: Datadog Status: Investigating an ingestion delay affecting eu-central-1. https://status.datadoghq.com/incident/67890
liam: Confirmed: most prod metrics haven't updated for ~10m. Alert flood on anomaly detectors. We need to stop noise and establish alternate visibility.
ops-bot: Auto-triggered runbook step: create incident page -> https://wiki.redwood/incidents/1767139999. Incident owner: @anna.
anna: Plan: 1) silence Datadog-based alerts for eu region, 2) enable internal metrics mirror (tsdb-mirror), 3) push recent logs to object store, 4) inform customers. I'll handle 1 and 4. Liam take 2+3.
liam: On it. Activating tsdb-mirror: `kubectl -n infra exec deploy/tsdb-mirror -- /bin/sh -c "start-mirror --region eu-central-1 --target=prometheus"` Then rebuild temporary Grafana dashboard `dash-1767139999`.
liam: Mirror started, ingest to internal Prometheus confirmed (metric `redwood.service.requests_total` present). Created temp Grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/obs-fallback/1767139999.
anna: Muting noisy alerts: `redwood-alerts mute --provider=datadog --region=eu-central-1 --duration=45m --reason="Datadog ingestion delay"`
support_julie: Notifying impacted customers via status page and support channels. Using template: `DD_INGEST_DELAY_EU`. Tickets created: CS-8821, CS-8822. Julia from account team already messaged top 5 customers.
datadog-status-bot: Update: backlog detected in ingestion pipeline; working on backlog processing. No ETA yet.
liam: Pushed last 2 hours of logs to S3: `aws s3 cp /var/log/api/ s3://redwood-incident-logs/1767139999/ --recursive` Logs confirmed. Also started local retention increase to avoid rotation loss.
anna: Good. Also enabling increased trace sampling in-prod so we have more distributed traces independent of Datadog: `telemetryctl set-sampling --service=api --rate=0.75`
liam: Traces sampling bumped. I can see more spans in our Jaeger instance.
anna: Ops note: don't remove mute until we validate metrics/alerts from Datadog are fully back AND we've compared to tsdb-mirror for at least 20 minutes. We'll follow staged unmute.
support_julie: Customers asking for ETA and whether historical data will be lost. I replied: "Datadog is processing backlog; we have a copy of recent logs and metrics in our mirror and S3; we'll reconcile once ingestion completes."
datadog-status-bot: Update: Backlog processing underway; partial ingestion observed. Expected reappearance window: 30-90 minutes per provider update.
liam: I see some metrics returning in Datadog but sparsely. Keeping mirror alive for +1h. Will start sync compare script to reconcile values: `python tools/reconcile_dd_mirror.py --since=1767138000`
anna: Good. Prepare short handoff briefing for next oncall in 20m. Handoff checklist: commands run, temp dashboards, customer ticket ids, current Datadog status link, mute token id, S3 path. Add owner: @support_julie for customer comms.
ops-bot: Reminder: runbook task 'post-incident followup' created -> assign to @liam and @anna.
anna: Postmortem notes to include: a) add automated detection for provider ingestion backlog (not just provider availability), b) add faster mirror enablement trigger, c) script to automate logs copy to S3 during ingestion anomalies.
liam: I'll file the followup tasks and a PR stub for mirror automation.
anna: Handoff to @support_julie in 20m. If Datadog flips to full recovery, we'll unmute alerts gradually: unmute -> monitor 30m -> disable mirror.
support_julie: Taking over monitoring and customer replies. Will update tickets with timeline and next steps.
anna: Thanks. Keep this thread updated with any customer impact or provider updates.
